You will use a consultative approach to connect technical capabilities with measurable customer and business outcomes. Working closely with Solutions Engineering, Marketing, SDRs, and leadership, you will shape opportunities while maintaining ownership of your pipeline and results. Contribute to the evolution of enterprise sales strategies and help strengthen processes as the business continues to scale. Demonstrated experience selling technical SaaS, API-first, developer-focused, security, identity, fraud, or comparable technology products to enterprise customers. Proven ability to generate self-sourced pipeline and create net-new opportunities through thoughtful, targeted outbound prospecting, particularly in environments with limited inbound demand. Strong experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles and building alignment across executives and technical decision-makers. Practical fluency with MEDDPICC or another structured sales qualification and methodology framework. Demonstrated ability to operate with ownership, curiosity, resourcefulness, and a proactive approach to investigating and solving problems. Strong communication, negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage both technical and business stakeholders. Excellent pipeline management, forecasting, CRM hygiene, and sales operations discipline. jobgether-jobgether:lever:589d954d-3487-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Project / Product Manager — PSP & Payment Integrations based in France. This role is ideal for a hands-on payments professional who understands payment integrations beyond the project-management layer. You will lead the end-to-end integration of PSPs, payment providers, and payment methods, from reviewing API documentation and configuring sandbox environments through testing, production launch, and post-release stabilization. You will work at the intersection of Product, Engineering, QA, business stakeholders, and external payment partners. The role combines delivery ownership with practical knowledge of APIs, transaction flows, authentication, webhooks, and payment operations. You will help shape priorities, manage dependencies, and ensure integrations are delivered reliably and efficiently. This is an environment with significant ownership, international payment infrastructure, and exposure to a broad range of providers and payment methods. Lead end-to-end integrations with new PSPs, payment providers, acquiring partners, and payment methods, from initial technical review through production launch and stabilization. Review API documentation and understand integration flows, including authentication, API keys, signatures, requests/responses, webhooks, callbacks, and transaction statuses. Translate integration requirements into clear, actionable tasks for Development and QA teams. Coordinate credentials, environments, merchant configuration, technical dependencies, blockers, testing activities, and release readiness. Collaborate closely with developers, QA specialists, business stakeholders, and external payment providers to keep integrations on track. Oversee sandbox, staging, and production testing, troubleshooting issues and coordinating post-release stabilization when required. Manage the payment integration backlog in Jira, including Epics, Tasks, dependencies, priorities, and Jira Plans. Plan delivery timelines and team capacity while maintaining visibility of risks, dependencies, and progress. Maintain accurate and accessible integration documentation in Confluence. Contribute to prioritization decisions around payment providers, integrations, and payment methods. Use a practical understanding of payment lifecycles, reconciliation, and financial flows to support effective delivery and issue resolution. Requirements Demonstrated hands-on experience with PSPs, payment gateways, acquiring, or payment processing , with direct involvement in payment provider integrations. Proven experience personally taking payment integrations from provider documentation and technical setup through testing and production launch, rather than managing them only at a high level. Strong understanding of REST APIs, request/response logic, webhooks, callbacks, authentication mechanisms, signatures, and API keys. Practical knowledge of deposits, payouts, transaction statuses, status mapping, sandbox/staging/production environments, error handling, and integration troubleshooting. Understanding of reconciliation and basic financial flows within payment processing. Experience coordinating cross-functional delivery across Product, Development, QA, business teams, and external payment providers. Experience with Jira and Confluence, including backlog management, prioritization, dependencies, documentation, and planning. Strong organizational and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders, timelines, and technical dependencies. Ability to independently explain a payment lifecycle and the technical flow of a provider integration. Experience in iGaming, betting, crypto, or forex payments is a strong advantage. jobgether-jobgether:lever:6a048d00-b862-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. You’ll collaborate closely with the Art Lead to develop concepts, refine assets, and maintain a consistent visual identity. Medical, dental, and vision coverage, depending on location, with additional insurance benefits available in certain countries.
